context.text: Lead ads start; daily views jump from about 15K to 70–98K until 13 Oct.
Second burst of lead ads, to 26 Oct.
Meta stopped reporting Facebook reach; viewers replaces it.
Instagram replied to 10.5% of messages in October, with an average reply time of 1h 47m (Meta inbox insights). 9 of 27 people who messaged came through ads.

Leads Centre shows 533 October leads; the ads report shows 397 form leads, 71 pixel leads and 78 workshop registrations (546). The two don't reconcile yet, and none of the 533 is marked converted, qualified or lost.
Grade-band lead ads (Grades 3–5, Nursery–PP2) ran 27–28 Oct: ₹19,799 for 44 leads.
